hub.title: Tools
hub.description: Creative and productivity tools at your fingertips.

tools.videoEditor_desc: Edit scenes on a canvas timeline, preview, and export.
tools.watermarkRemover_desc: Remove watermarks from images and short video clips.

video.title: Video Editor
video.description: Edit scenes on a canvas timeline, preview instantly, and export right in the browser, or send heavy jobs to the server render.
video.source_hint: Workspace path (e.g. images/scene1.png) or https:// URL
video.caption: Caption
video.delete_confirm_desc: The job and its rendered MP4 file will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
video.cancel_confirm_desc: The job will stop and its partial output discarded.
video.empty_jobs: No render jobs yet. Compose a storyboard and hit Render.
video.not_enabled: Video rendering is not enabled on this server.
video.worker_note: Jobs are processed by the video worker; progress updates automatically.
video.limit_hint: Up to 60 scenes, 1–30s each, 10 min total.

render_panel.title: Render Settings
render_panel.client_hint: Browser export records the canvas in real time (video only, no background music). Longer videos take longer to export.
render_panel.overloaded_warning: Browser overloaded -- encoding is too slow. Consider using server export.
render_panel.overloaded_fallback: Browser overloaded -- falling back to server export.

video.advanced_hint: Applied in browser preview and client-side export; the server render ignores these.

watermark.title: Watermark Remover
watermark.description: Remove watermarks from images and short videos entirely in your browser, including Gemini watermarks on AI images. Files never leave your device.
watermark.privacy: 100% local, nothing is uploaded. Only the visible watermark is targeted (not invisible marks like SynthID).
watermark.drop_hint: or click to browse (PNG/JPEG/WebP, batch supported)
watermark.credits: Algorithm: gemini-watermark-remover (MIT) by GargantuaX, based on AllenK's reverse alpha blending method.
watermark.usage_note: Use only on images you have the rights to modify. You are responsible for complying with applicable terms of service.

video.auto_note: The Gemini watermark is removed automatically per frame via inverse alpha blending (gemini-watermark-remover); processing happens entirely in your browser.
